newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cartel office bars Springer buy of PSG.
newsitem.headline: Cartel office bars Springer buy of PSG.

text.p: Germany's cartel office said on Monday that it had blocked the takeover by publishing group Axel Springer Verlag AG of German Post Office unit Postdienst Service Gmbh (PSG).
The cartel office said in a statement that a takeover of PSG -- which runs newspaper kiosks in eastern Germany -- would have strengthened Springer's market dominance.
The Berlin-based cartel authority said that the Springer group had a dominant position both nationwide and in Berlin through its Bild and B.Z. newspapers and its Sunday papers.
Meanwhile, around Rostock and Leipzig, Springer also had dominant market positions through its Ostsee-Zeitung and its Leipziger Volkszeitung subscription papers.
A takeover of PSG would harm access for other newspaper publishers to sales outlets, as well as put into question the neutrality of distribution of the print media in Germany, the cartel office said.
The authority's ruling is not yet legally binding, and Springer still has the right to appeal, it added.
